in_sanskrit.name: Fanish
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Graceful, auspicious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Fanish एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'fanidhana', meaning 'one who holds or preserves wealth, prosperity, and blessings'. This name is associated with the grace, blessings, and prosperity granted by the gods.
